levels.title: Newcomer
levels.blurb: A borrowed basket, two zones and the basic kit.

levels.title: Gatherer
levels.blurb: The village knows your name. Carry a favorite tool into the new year.

levels.title: Forager
levels.blurb: The chandler starts stocking lanterns and blight spray for you.

levels.title: Grower
levels.blurb: You clear the brambles behind the shed and run a drip line to it, and the first year's profits come back to you.

levels.title: Mycophile
levels.blurb: An old forester sketches you a map of last summer's fire.

levels.title: Steward
levels.blurb: A neighbor's kid starts helping out on the farm, and the woodlot up the lane is yours to farm if you like.

levels.title: Elder of the Wood
levels.blurb: People bring you mushrooms to identify now, and a fisherman sells you his old waders.

levels.title: Pathfinder
levels.blurb: A charcoal burner shows you the path into the Hollow.

levels.title: Lorekeeper
levels.blurb: Your apprentice picks every ripe bed at first light.

levels.title: Legend of the Valley
levels.blurb: The miller's family offers you the old orchard, and the village sings about your festivals.

mastery.name: Familiar
mastery.rule: Lookalikes fool you on one fewer number.

mastery.name: Expert
mastery.rule: You know it on sight: it comes home already identified.

challenges.name: Lean Year
challenges.rule: Start with no coins and no heirlooms.

challenges.name: Thin Basket
challenges.rule: Your basket holds one fewer specimen.
